days.lo: I will understand equal groups as multiplication by identifying the relationship between repeated addition sentences, unit form, and multiplication equations.
I am learning to relate multiplication facts to the array model by using rows and columns.
I am learning to interpret the meaning of factors—the size of the group or the number of groups.
I am learning to model and solve division problems by finding the size of each group.
I will learn to model and solve division problems by finding the number of equal groups.
I will interpret the unknown in division by using an array model to connect multiplication and division.
I am learning to demonstrate the commutative property of multiplication by rotating arrays 90 degrees to practice related facts.
I am learning to find related multiplication facts by adding or subtracting equal groups in array models to solve larger facts.
I am learning to model the distributive property with arrays to decompose units as a strategy to multiply.
I am learning to model division as the unknown factor in multiplication using arrays and strip diagrams.
I am learning to interpret the quotient as the number of groups or the number of objects in each group using units of 2.
I am learning to skip-count objects or model to build fluency with multiplication facts using units of 4.
I am learning to represent arrays and strip diagrams to model the commutative property of multiplication.
I am learning to use the distributive property as a strategy to find related multiplication facts.
I am learning to apply the distributive property as a strategy to multiply and divide with units of 4 with arrays and strip diagrams.
